clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, Ayanna Everstride trains young kaldorei in the hunter’s way. Stationed in Aldrassil, she teaches marksmanship, tracking, and survival beneath the World Tree.

Ayanna Everstride trains newly awakened kaldorei hunters inside Aldrassil, in the heart of Shadowglen. To the night elves, hunters are indispensable guardians of the sacred forests, not merely trappers or sharpshooters. Ayanna teaches novices early martial skills, ranged combat, and how to survive Teldrassil’s perilous woods.
